title: vsift watch failure data
description: The data member of a failed watch result, only when the run was given --keep and failed after its job sealed, a final write refused for example (0.3.0, ADR 0037, amendment of 2026-10-30). The error says what failed, as for any failed watch; this says what became of the bundle, because the transcript exists and the person asked to keep it. kept.state is kept when the bundle was written anyway, and session_closed is then true; it is not_kept with failure_code when that failed too, and the session is then left open (session_closed false) so that session retain can still export it. Every other failed watch has a null data member. Validate the envelope with operation-response.schema.json.
